user_stories.goal: generate a weekly study plan from my course details
user_stories.benefit: I can organise study time more effectively
acceptance_criteria: Given valid inputs, when I submit the form, then the system returns a weekly plan.
The response includes daily tasks, estimated hours, revision advice, and risk flags.

user_stories.goal: see a sample plan before entering my own information
user_stories.benefit: I can understand what the system produces
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/sample-plan returns a valid example plan.
The example contains the same structure as a generated plan.

user_stories.goal: check the health of the deployed API
user_stories.benefit: I can verify that deployment is working
acceptance_criteria: The response uses JSON and HTTP 200.

user_stories.benefit: I reduce the risk of releasing broken code
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions runs the tests on push.
